resolutions.gpu_ref: 160x90 stack (same decode as series; fps=T/10s measured)
resolutions.series: every decoded frame at 160x90 rgb24 via ffmpeg scale=160:90

feature_groups.B_*: 40 arm-B T1 scalars (8 families); units per docs/reports/spectral_features.md
feature_groups.G_*: 26 GPU CPU-reference scalars (jadal/gpu/features.py FEATURE_NAMES); luma fractions in [0,1], energies raw, shift in px, illum normalised
feature_groups.P_*: jadal/perpixel/series.py descriptors: band fractions of non-DC energy, entropy nats/ln(nbins), ac peak/lag(frames), burstiness=std/|mean|, motion floor=median+MAD of diff_e, still_run_frac, shift px@160x90, saturation fractions, dct_hf log1p-mean
